Package game.travel

Class DestinationList

java.lang.Object
game.travel.DestinationList
public class DestinationList extends Object
The destinations reachable through one travel mechanism. It is shared by every mechanism (a Ground such as a ladder, an Item such as the alien device) so that none of them repeats the bookkeeping, and so that any mechanism can lead to several destinations.
